# Font Awesome icons in phone-ui's fonts, beyond LVGL's symbols (LV_SYMBOL_*): one a
# line, its name and codepoint as Font Awesome's metadata/icons.yml gives them, from
# Font Awesome 7 Free Solid (the flake's FONTAWESOME). gen-fonts.sh adds their glyphs to
# every ui_font_<size> and writes src/ui_symbols.h: UI_SYMBOL_<NAME>, a UTF-8 string
# for a label, as LV_SYMBOL_* are. A codepoint of LVGL's symbols is refused (both are
# Font Awesome's: its glyph would replace LVGL's).
#
# Icons: https://fontawesome.com/search?ic=free&s=solid

tower-broadcast f519	# the mobile network: the shade's row
